# Dialog
Atlas Dialog v1 — modal with header (title + close), description, footer actions. 2 intents × 5 sizes × 2 states (20 total).

USE WHEN
· Confirming a destructive or irreversible action, a short focused form, or a detail view that must not lose the page behind it.

DON'T USE WHEN
· A message that needs no decision → Alert.
· A decision that must be made, with no close control → AlertDialog.
· Long content that deserves its own page.

DO
· Always give it a title; it names the dialog for screen readers.
· Put the confirming action last in the footer, cancel before it.
· Say in the description what will happen and what cannot be undone.

DON'T
· Stack dialogs.

PROPERTIES
Variant: default | destructive. Size: sm | md | lg | xl | full. State: default | loading.
